title.zh: Bank of Japan raises interest rates by 25 basis points. Bitcoin tops $77,000
title.en: Bank of Japan raises interest rates by 25 basis points. Bitcoin tops $77,000

current_state.zh: The Bank of Japan raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 1.25%, the highest in 31 years, amid sticky inflation and a weak yen, with bitcoin rising above $77,000 and the yen falling in response.
